claim: The default quota is 5 internet gateways per Region; to raise it, raise the quota for VPCs per Region. Only one internet gateway can be attached to a VPC at a time.
question: How many internet gateways can an account have per Region, and how many can be attached to one VPC?

values.display: only one internet gateway to a VPC at a time

qualifiers.condition: raised through the VPCs per Region quota
